reviews.text: Good to find a groomer who cares about the dog's best interests, wonderful experience!
Fantastic dog groomer where we have always been happy with the cut of our American Cocker Spaniel.
Sara is so great and kind. She accommodated my request immediately and was very flexible and attentive to the dog's and owners' needs. We would love to come again! Big hug from us!

We had the best experience ever as a new costumer! We had recently adopted an adult dog who we were told did not like water or being brushed. We had also noticed that he experienced some anxiety and were not fond of new people, so we were quite anxious about his groom or if they would be be able to groom him at all. Our experience was wonderful! Sara did an amazing job! He apparently did really well and even though he was a bit scared when I first brought him in, he was a completely different dog when I picked him up! In just an hour and 50 minutes he was done! He had completely warmed up to Sara and he was so beautiful and clean! We would 100% recommend taking your pet here! Sara was so understanding of his situation and his anxiety and took him seriously and assured us that if anything were to happen she would let us know and we would try again the next day, however it was not needed as she took really good care of him! We will definitely come back!

A top-notch groomer who makes your dog a star.
Entrust your pet to her with complete confidence.

I had an absolutely fantastic experience as a first-time customer! The ladies at the dog grooming salon were exceptionally nice and professional. They took such great care of my dog and the end result was truly amazing. If you're in search of a top-notch dog groomer, look no further because these ladies are undoubtedly the best in Oslo. I am thrilled to say that I am now a loyal customer!
